what: data-fx-part="line" Several sentences in turn — typed one character at a time at .045s, held for 2.8s, then erased one character at a time at .02s, with a .4s rest before the next sentence. After the last one it loops back to the first, endlessly. The full current sentence is given to readers as hidden text

options.type: Interval for typing one character (sec), default .045
options.hold: Hold time after typing finishes (s), default 2.8
options.erase: Interval for erasing one character (sec), default .02
options.gap: Rest time after fully erased (s), default .4
options.[data-fx-part=line]: One per sentence to rotate (only the text inside is read)

use: Your first sentence here.Your second sentence here.
note: type-on types once when visible and ends, while this one cycles through several sentences, typing and erasing. With reduced motion, only the first sentence is left as is

from.where: index.html header subtitle .js-header-lead (shared.js vt.typeLead) — original hx {type .045, hold 2.8, erase .02, gap .4}, starts when the heading gets data-show
